summary: The CI failure is caused by remote-only AI and Vectorize bindings being declared in the local Wrangler config. Explicit --local avoids token authentication, but the unusable Vectorize placeholder still causes deletion to fail. The safe boundary is explicit local mode plus omission of non-emulatable bindings from wrangler.local.toml.
decision_refs: Add --local to the CI wrangler dev command instead of adding Cloudflare credentials.
Omit AI and Vectorize from wrangler.local.toml while keeping all local-safe bindings aligned with production.
Give the smoke key an explicit tenant_admin policy because the default API key is now intentionally service_agent.
residual_risks: The full smoke still needs an unrestricted loopback bind because the sandbox blocks local ports.
